answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit that vests slowly, like sediment settling into shale: cheap identities cannot afford many deposits at once. Pair the deposit with a peer-reviewed work history carved in marble — public, hard to forge, and slow to accumulate — so a new identity starts with zero trust. Finally, route payouts through a lagoon of delayed settlement: rewards pool for one full epoch before release, letting the network drain fake accounts before they cash out.
